key_facts.title: SKA AT THE SHACK

other: Lineup: SKALDIK (Skapunklorik Orchestra from Chile), The Hellas (Bay Area ska punk), Rock Shed Rangers (outlaw ska from Santa Cruz)

difficulty: Black-and-white photocopy style with distressed, stencil-like display fonts; the band name 'SKALDIK' is highly stylized and hard to read; text over busy collage images; two bands side by side in the middle (reading order is ambiguous); tiny labels under band names; background collage contains stray fragments like 'NOV 27' that are not part of the event; no AM/PM on times.
notes: I'm not 100% sure the main band name is spelled SKALDIK (the L is stylized), please check it against the flyer. The background collage text ('NOV 27' near the CHILE label, fragments at the top) is excluded from the ground truth. Times have no AM/PM on the flyer; evening is implied.
